exposure: Breastfeeding support model based on King's Goal Attainment Theory (goal negotiation, dynamic assessment, interactive feedback)
cohort: The study involved 120 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered at a tertiary hospital between March 2022 and March 2024.
finding: The breastfeeding support model based on King's Goal Attainment Theory significantly improved breastfeeding rates, self-efficacy, glycemic control, and neonatal outcomes in women with GDM compared to routine support.
